Time to make the switch

Get £240 when you switch to our Everyday Current Account and save at least £200 with our Regular Saver

How to switch

Offer is only available if you didn’t hold a Santander Current Account on 1 January 2026, or if you haven’t previously received a Santander switcher incentive. T&Cs and exclusions apply. Offer may be withdrawn at any time.

Fraudsters use events like the Microsoft outage, and busy shopping periods like Black Friday and Cyber Monday, to target you with scams.

Stay alert - stop, think and verify before taking any action.

Here for you 

We won't make any further branch closures before 2028. Find out more about banking in our branches

Fancy £250,000 cash?

We’re offering a chance to win a share of £100,000 each month, plus a grand prize of £250,000 in December. You need to have a Santander personal current account to be eligible. 18+, T&Cs apply, opt-in required. The prize draw ends 31 December 2026.

Customer prize draw

Your big plans don’t need to wait

Use our eligibility checker to find out if you can get a loan. It won’t hurt your credit score. All credit is subject to status and credit checks. You might be offered a different rate from the representative APR.

Get a loan

Get 3% cashback for one year

On petrol, everyday travel, eating out and takeaways.
24.9% APR representative (variable). Credit subject to status and credit checks. T&Cs apply.

Rewards Credit Card

Support for Personal customers

Help protect the ones you love

Get a minimum of £100 cashback on a new life insurance policy. T&Cs apply. This offer can be withdrawn at any time. Cover provided by Aviva.

Safe in your hands

Dive into the features of our award-winning app. It's quick, easy and above all, secure.

Help when you need it


If you're dealing with rising energy costs, need tips on budgeting, have missed a payment or struggling to keep up, we're here to help.

Independent service quality survey results

Personal current accounts (GB)

Published August 2026

As part of a regulatory requirement, an independent survey was conducted to ask approximately 1,000 customers of each of the 17 largest personal current account providers if they would recommend their provider to friends and family. The results represent the view of customers who took part in the survey.

Take a look at the latest published results

Personal current accounts (NI)

Published August 2026

As part of a regulatory requirement, an independent survey was conducted to ask approximately 500 customers of each of the 12 largest personal current account providers if they would recommend their provider to friends and family. The results represent the view of customers who took part in the survey.

Take a look at the latest published results

As part of a separate regulatory requirement, we have also published the Financial Conduct Authority service quality information for personal current accounts.

Authorised push payment (APP) fraud rankings in 2024


Authorised push payment (APP) scams happen when someone is tricked into transferring money to a fraudster’s bank account. Information about Santander’s performance prior to the introduction of the reimbursement requirement in October 2024 can be found in PSR’s latest APP Scams Performance Report published in February 2026.
